headline: Democrats Gain Control of Congress, Signaling New Regulatory Direction for Crypto
summary: Following midterms, Democrats have secured majorities in the Senate and House, breaking the previous Republican dominance across government branches and setting a new direction for the cryptocurrency industry.
why: Shifts in congressional majorities directly impact legislative priorities, regulatory oversight, and policy formulation for the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency Market
impacts.why: Change in congressional control introduces uncertainty regarding future digital asset regulations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A shift in legislative control alters the outlook for federal oversight and regulatory policy affecting digital assets.
